deadline.value: Priority for admission and fellowships goes to applications received by December 1; review continues on a rolling basis into spring.
deadline.quote: PhD applications are reviewed starting in mid-December, with priority for admission and fellowship opportunities given to applications received by December 1.

gre_general.value: No GRE is required for any BME graduate program.
gre_general.quote: A GRE score is no longer required for applicants to any BME graduate program.

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers are not generally available from the program; routes exist mostly for domestic applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: Application fee waivers are not generally available from our program.

supervisor.value: PhD applicants are encouraged to contact faculty directly to find a funded position.
supervisor.quote: PhD applicants are encouraged to contact specific faculty of interest directly in order to establish a connection that might lead to a funded position.

funding.value: The program admits only PhD applicants it can fund, via GRA and fellowship appointments.
funding.quote: We admit only those PhD applicants we can fund.
